title: Glowing bicycle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Wheels -->
  <circle cx="25" cy="65" r="16" fill="none" stroke="#33FFAA" stroke-width="3.5"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="65" r="16" fill="none" stroke="#33FFAA" stroke-width="3.5"/>
  <!-- Wheel inner glow -->
  <circle cx="25" cy="65" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#22DD88" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="65" r="12" fill="none" stroke="#22DD88" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Spokes -->
  <line x1="25" y1="49" x2="25" y2="81" stroke="#55FFBB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="9" y1="65" x2="41" y2="65" stroke="#55FFBB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="14" y1="54" x2="36" y2="76" stroke="#55FFBB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="36" y1="54" x2="14" y2="76" stroke="#55FFBB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="75" y1="49" x2="75" y2="81" stroke="#55FFBB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="59" y1="65" x2="91" y2="65" stroke="#55FFBB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="64" y1="54" x2="86" y2="76" stroke="#55FFBB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="86" y1="54" x2="64" y2="76" stroke="#55FFBB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Frame -->
  <line x1="25" y1="65" x2="45" y2="40" stroke="#FF6688" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="45" y1="40" x2="60" y2="65" stroke="#FF6688" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="60" y1="65" x2="75" y2="65" stroke="#FF6688" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="25" y1="65" x2="60" y2="65" stroke="#FF6688" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="45" y1="40" x2="65" y2="40" stroke="#FF8899" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Seat -->
  <rect x="58" y="34" width="16" height="6" rx="3" fill="#FFAA44"/>
  <!-- Handlebar -->
  <line x1="65" y1="40" x2="72" y2="30" stroke="#FF6688" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="68" y1="28" x2="78" y2="28" stroke="#FFAA44" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Pedal -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="68" r="4" fill="#FFAA44"/>
  <line x1="45" y1="68" x2="45" y2="78" stroke="#FFAA44" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="78" x2="50" y2="78" stroke="#FFDD55" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Chain hint -->
  <path d="M25,68 Q35,78 45,72" fill="none" stroke="#44EEAA" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Headlight glow -->
  <circle cx="72" cy="30" r="4" fill="#FFEE55" opacity="0.9"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="30" r="7" fill="#FFEE55" opacity="0.25"/>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <circle cx="85" cy="20" r="1.5" fill="#AAFFDD"/>
  <circle cx="10" cy="35" r="1.5" fill="#AAFFDD"/>
  <circle cx="90" cy="48" r="1" fill="#AAFFDD"/>
  <circle cx="5" cy="88" r="1" fill="#AAFFDD"/>
</svg>
